A tree seed roasted to amplify its fragrance. Gives more hearts than the raw variety.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Tree Nuts are a type of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by exposing [[Chickaloo Tree Nut]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} These Nuts have a better fragrance than their uncooked counterpart. Eating one restores one [[Heart]] to Link's [[Life Gauge]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Tree Nuts reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Chickaloo Tree Nut]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. These Nuts have a better fragrance than their uncooked counterpart. Eating one restores half a [[Heart]] to Link's [[Life Gauge]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Chickaloo Tree Nut * Food * Roasted Acorn * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
